en.title: Which transit card fits you?

q.ask: How do you want to pay?

climate.name: Climate Card
climate.why: Unlimited Seoul rides at a flat price — best for heavy city use.

tmoney.name: T-money
tmoney.why: Pay per ride and it works nationwide — flexible for lighter or regional trips.

wowpass.name: WOWPASS
wowpass.why: Load your home currency and pay cashless, with T-money built in.

climate.name: 기후동행카드

tmoney.why: 탄 만큼 내고 전국에서 사용 — 적게 타거나 지방 이동에 유연.

wowpass.name: WOWPASS
wowpass.why: 자국 통화를 충전해 현금 없이 결제, T-money 내장.
